bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs (SMAppService.mainApp), springboard/proto/src/extras.rs, springboard/src/shell/extras.rs, springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (Settings > General > Login Items)
summary: Login items for the app itself are covered: register, unregister, refresh and a four-case status enum, with the shell keeping the list and starting the apps at session start. Launch agents, launch daemons, embedded helper executables, the completion-handler and legacy APIs, the error constants and the deprecated SMJob/SMLoginItemSetEnabled calls have no BifrOSt counterpart.

features.feature: Login item for the main app (SMAppService.mainApp)
features.note: register and unregister are asynchronous: the result arrives as App::login_item_status with the request id; Apple returns it inline or through a completion handler

features.feature: Refresh and status of the login item
features.note: NotRegistered, Enabled, RequiresApproval and NotFound all exist; RequiresApproval is never produced because there is no approval step
only the request-id form exists; the error value is not returned to the app

Wave 3 (w3-service-management, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. BifrOSt login items are app ids only; no helper bundles

Wave 3 (w3-service-management, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no launch agent plist is loaded from an app bundle; bifrostd is the system supervisor and is not exposed to apps

Wave 3 (w3-service-management, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no SDK API for root daemons shipped in an app bundle

features.apple: helper executables inside the app's main bundle, registered through SMAppService
features.note: the SDK doc states BifrOSt has no embedded login-item helpers, launch agents or daemons

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (Login Items page, LoginItemRemove action); springboard/src/shell/extras.rs (login.items pref)
features.note: the page exists and lets the user remove items, but apps cannot open it through an SDK call
BifrOSt has no earlier login-item plist format to check

features.apple: kSMErrorAlreadyRegistered, kSMErrorJobNotFound, kSMErrorLaunchDeniedByUser and the other kSMError values, SMAppServiceErrorDomain
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-14, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. the SDK has no error type; the shell reply carries only a status, so failures cannot be reported with Apple's codes

Wave 4 (theme-20, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. deprecated by Apple; a desktop equivalent would sit on the bifrostd and app policy layers (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs), none exposed to apps

features.apple: SMJobSubmit, SMJobRemove, SMJobCopyDictionary, SMCopyAllJobDictionaries and the kSMDomain constants
features.note: deprecated launchd C API tied to Apple's launchd; BifrOSt's supervisor is bifrostd with no app-facing job API
deprecated by Apple in favour of SMAppService; the SDK exposes only the replacement shape

gaps: Launch agents and launch daemons: SMAppService.agent(plistName:) and daemon(plistName:) (the SDK doc states none exist)
Embedded helper executables registered from the app bundle, including loginItem(identifier:)
Service Management error values (kSMError*, SMAppServiceErrorDomain): the SDK has no error type and the shell reply carries no error
unregister(completionHandler:) and the error value it returns
openSystemSettingsLoginItems(): the shell page exists but no SDK call opens it
Deprecated SMJobBless, SMLoginItemSetEnabled and the SMJob* launchd functions have no counterpart
